./.title: Overview
./.body:
English · 简体中文

Heygo AI Passport project summary

Snapshot: 2026-10-18, main commit c865ba8.
Each statement shows its source: a file path and line, or a git commit.

Summary
AI Passport is a small handheld device for skiers.
During a rest, the user can see the data of the last run and ask the AI coach.
The user does not take out the phone or remove the gloves.
The code for all four increments is complete, and the host tests pass.
Nobody ran a device test yet.
Status



Increment
Function
Status




1 Coach voice
Long press OK opens the Coach page. Hold OK to ask a question. The device plays the answer.
Code complete. Device test not run.


2 Run data and report
Speed, drop, distance, turns, and time. Heygo IQ (0 to 200) for each run. The device opens the live data page at run start (D-32).
Code complete. Device test not run.


3 Turns
The line of each run, 8 turns on each page.
Code complete. Device test not run.


4 Phone popups (D-31)
Fall alert, voice notice, issue report, or achievement report. A 10 s countdown.
Code complete. Host tests pass. Device test not run.


D-33 Page rail
A rail on the right side shows the position in the page loop.
The simulator shows the rail. Firmware work has not started.



Sources: README.md, section "What the device does". 需求文件夹/04-validation-and-decisions.md, D-33 row.
Top three items

Use a development board. Sprint 5 is the first sprint that needs a board. All later integration sprints need it (需求文件夹/08-sprint-roadmap.md).
Get the phone app team to confirm D-20, D-31, and D-32. These three decisions wait for that team.
Get the HeygoAI coach capability (Q-01). Sprint 8 needs it. There is no answer yet.

For more items, see Open items and risks.
Links

Simulator: https://azuresword.github.io/Heygo-AiPassport/
Repository: https://github.com/Azuresword/Heygo-AiPassport
Book source: summary-book/. Run summary-book/build.sh to make summary/ again.

product.html.title: Product and architecture
product.html.body:
English · 简体中文

Product and architecture
Four pages
The four pages are at the same level and make a loop.
A short press of UP or DOWN changes the page.
A long press of OK on any page opens the Coach page (D-29).



Page
Content
Decision




Live data
The phone sends one frame each second. Heygo IQ is 0 to 200.
D-23, D-27


Report
One report at the end of each run.
D-26


Turns
8 turns on each page. The device keeps 3 groups and asks for others with TURN_REQUEST.
D-30


AI coach
The user holds OK and speaks. The phone does speech-to-text, the AI answer, and text-to-speech.
D-17



The phone can also start two events:

Popup (D-31): POPUP 0x66 and POPUP_END 0x67. A popup stops any state. The device plays the voice and then counts down 10 s. Any key closes the popup.
Run start (D-32): RUN_START 0x68. The device opens the live data page. During a talk or a popup, the device opens the page after the talk or popup ends.

Sources: README.md. 需求文件夹/04-validation-and-decisions.md, rows D-30 to D-32.
Device and phone tasks
The device controls only the keys, microphone, speaker, and screen.
The phone does speech recognition, speech synthesis, run data, and the AI coach (D-14).
 +-------- Device --------+   BLE NUS    +--------- Phone ---------+
 | 3 keys / mic / speaker |  | speech in / speech out  |
 | 240x320 screen         |  IMA ADPCM   | run data / AI coach     |
 +------------------------+  16kHz 20ms  +-------------------------+

The link is BLE only. The device does not use Wi-Fi (D-08).
Audio is IMA ADPCM. Raw PCM is the fallback (D-09).
The link has no encryption and no pairing (D-12).
The protocol version is 0.2. The phone app team confirmed it (D-16).

Hardware and software



Item
Value




Controller
ESP32-C3, 8 MB flash, no PSRAM


Screen
ST7789P3, 240 × 320, SPI2


Keys
UP, DOWN, and OK on GPIO0 through an ADC divider


Audio
ES8311, full-duplex I2S


Fuel gauge
CW2017


SDK
ESP-IDF 5.5.3, LVGL 9.5.0, NimBLE



Source: Firmware/docs/README.md, hardware section.
Repository layout



Path
Content




Firmware/
ESP-IDF firmware. It is a copy of upstream FoloToy/ai-passport at 3d685a9, with the MIT license (Firmware/docs/heygo-changes.md).


Firmware/flows/coach.flow.json
The state machine. The firmware and the simulator use the same file.


Firmware/tests/
33 test_* host tests.


Firmware/tools/
phone_sim (phone stand-in), host_render (screen tests on the host), flow/flow_sim.py (makes the simulator).


需求文件夹/
Documents 01 to 08, in English and Chinese.


assets/sim/coach-flow.html
The single-file simulator. A script makes it. Do not edit it manually.

build-and-deploy.html.title: Checks and deployment
build-and-deploy.html.body:
English · 简体中文

Checks and deployment
Gate

Activate ESP-IDF 5.5.3.
In Firmware, run ./tools/validate.sh.
Make sure that the last line is Firmware build: PASS.

The gate also runs these checks (Firmware/docs/heygo-changes.md, section 3):



Check
What it finds




Host tests
33 test_* files in Firmware/tests/.


Glyph check
Screen text that the font cannot show.


host_render
Screen overlap, memory pool leaks, and cut UTF-8 text.


flow_sim --check and --run-selftest
Differences between the simulator and the state machine. The self-test runs in headless Chrome.



Last recorded result: host tests pass, and the simulator self-test is 117/117.
These are host results. They do not prove that the device works.
validate.sh lines 60 to 63 support macOS.
The Apple linker has no --gc-sections, so the script uses -dead_strip.
CI
The workflows are in Firmware/.github/workflows/: build-firmware, firmware-checks, static-checks, and sync-main.
GitHub reads workflows only from .github/workflows/ at the repository root.
This repository has no .github/ at the root.
Thus, these workflows possibly do not run.
This is an inference. We did not examine the Actions page.
Deployment

GitHub Pages publishes the root of main. The root has a .nojekyll file.
index.html opens assets/sim/coach-flow.html.
This book is in summary/. After you change summary-book/, run summary-book/build.sh.

一页 8 个弯；设备存 3 组，其余用 TURN_REQUEST 请求
D-30


AI 教练
按住说话，手机转写、问 AI、合成语音
D-17



手机还能触发两类事件：

弹窗（D-31）：POPUP 0x66 / POPUP_END 0x67。立即打断任何状态，播语音后倒计时 10 秒，任意键关闭。
开始滑行（D-32）：RUN_START 0x68。设备打开实时数据页；对话中或弹窗中则等结束后再打开。

来源：README.zh_CN.md:8-10；需求文件夹/04-validation-and-decisions.zh_CN.md:151-153
设备和手机怎么分工
设备只管按键、麦克风、喇叭、屏幕。语音识别、语音合成、滑行数据、AI 教练都在手机上（D-14）。
 ┌──────── 设备 ────────┐   BLE NUS    ┌──────── 手机 ────────┐
 │ 3 键 / 麦克风 / 喇叭 │ ◄──────────► │ 语音识别 / 合成        │
 │ 240×320 屏幕         │  IMA ADPCM   │ 滑行数据 / AI 教练     │
 └──────────────────────┘  16kHz 20ms  └───────────────────────┘

只走 BLE，不用 Wi-Fi（D-08）。
音频 IMA ADPCM，裸 PCM 做回退（D-09）。
不加密、不配对（D-12）。
协议版本 0.2，App 团队已确认（D-16）。

门禁与部署
门禁

激活 ESP-IDF 5.5.3。
在 Firmware 里运行 ./tools/validate.sh。
最后一行应是 Firmware build: PASS。

门禁除基线检查外还跑这些（Firmware/docs/heygo-changes.zh_CN.md:38-74）：



检查
查什么




主机测试
Firmware/tests/ 下 33 个 test_*


字形检查
屏幕文字在字体里都有


host_render
界面重叠、内存池泄漏、UTF-8 截断


flow_sim --check / --run-selftest
模拟器和状态机一致；在无界面 Chrome 里跑自测



最近记录的结果：主机测试通过，模拟器自测 117/117（heygo-changes.zh_CN.md:317）。
这些都是主机上的结果，不等于设备能跑。
validate.sh:60-63 已处理 macOS：苹果链接器没有 --gc-sections，改用 -dead_strip。
CI
workflow 在 Firmware/.github/workflows/：build-firmware、firmware-checks、static-checks、sync-main。
GitHub 只读仓库根目录的 .github/workflows/。这个仓库根目录没有 .github/，所以这些 workflow 可能不会运行。这是推断，没在 Actions 页核实。
部署

index.html 跳到 assets/sim/coach-flow.html（index.html:8）。
本书发布在 summary/。改了 summary-book/ 后运行 summary-book/build.sh 重新生成。
